capabilities: Manage kanban boards with drag-and-drop lists and cards
Store each card as a Markdown note in its own board folder
Edit cards with labels, start/due dates, details, and checklists
Sync boards two-way with Nextcloud Deck via the REST API
Resolve field-level sync conflicts with configurable policies
extras: Attachment sync is opt-in and marked experimental (single-request uploads only; chunked upload planned). Pre-releases are installed via BRAT; the manifest notes the plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Forked from Task Deck and refocused on Nextcloud as the sync backend.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in kanban boards, and kanban tools that sync usually rely on third-party clouds instead of cards kept as plain Markdown files.

relations.evidence: Forked from Task Deck and refocused on Nextcloud as the sync backend.
two-way sync against the Nextcloud Deck REST API

requires.name: Nextcloud with the Deck app (Deck ≥ 1.9 recommended)
Nextcloud account with an App Password

summary: Kanban plugin that stores every card as a Markdown note in the vault and syncs boards two-way with Nextcloud Deck.
